methods.description: Reciprocate equivalent rates to put unknown time on top.
Scale quantities per100 and reverse for distance.
Derive a rate from differences, then apply to the remaining amount.
Find the relevant total area, mass or remaining money before applying the rate.
Calculate the needed quantity and compare with available capacity.
Convert forward, subtract spending and convert back using the reciprocal rate.
Maintain a multiplicative rate rather than add unequal quantities.
